ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Desktopimgdownldr Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious Microsoft desktopimgdownldr execution with parameters used to download files from the Internet

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/lockscreenurl\\:.*") AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.png.*")))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ delete.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\PersonalizationCSP.*"))
